references.text: Refers to the place the Lord will choose, where Israelites shall bring their offerings and eat before the Lord with their families
Commands that tithes and firstborns be eaten before the Lord at the place He chooses, together with the whole household
Describes the annual meal before the Lord at the place He chooses, to learn to fear the Lord
Commands rejoicing before the Lord at the place He chooses, together with the whole household
All men shall appear before the Lord three times a year at the place He chooses
Earlier command that all men shall appear before the Lord God three times a year
Repeats the command to appear before the Lord three times a year
